media_work.title: Deadline
media_work.focus_or_theme: Illinois Governor George Ryan's struggle with the state's flawed death penalty system, prompted by exonerations and Northwestern University investigations, culminating in his commutation of all death sentences.
media_work.summaryNotes: Highlights the series of wrongful convictions uncovered on Illinois' death row and documents Governor Ryan's commutation of over 160 death sentences to life imprisonment in 2003.

media_item.focus_or_theme: Illinois Governor George Ryan's struggle with the state's flawed death penalty system, prompted by exonerations and Northwestern University investigations, culminating in his commutation of all death sentences.
media_item.summary_notes: Documents Illinois Governor George Ryan's decision to commute all death sentences in Illinois after a series of wrongful convictions were uncovered. Features interviews with Governor Ryan, his staff, journalists, and lawyers.
key_quotes_raw: Interviews with Governor Ryan, his staff, journalists, lawyers, potentially exonerees or their families.
Footage of the clemency hearings and Ryan's final announcement commuting the sentences.
systemic_issues_raw: High rate of error and wrongful convictions in capital punishment cases
Systemic flaws in the criminal justice system (police/prosecutorial misconduct, inadequate defense)
The role of journalism and academic investigation in uncovering injustice
Political and moral dilemmas surrounding the death penalty.
policy_recommendations_raw: The film documents a major policy action (blanket commutation) and implicitly supports moratoriums or abolition of the death penalty due to the risk of executing the innocent.

external_links_raw.description: Reports from Northwestern's Center on Wrongful Convictions, news archives covering the Illinois death penalty moratorium.

featured_individuals.narrative_summary: The documentary features several Illinois death row exonerees who were exonerated or had their sentences commuted by Gov. Ryan. Their cases highlight flaws in the criminal justice system.
organizations_involved_raw: Northwestern University's Center on Wrongful Convictions

featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Anthony Porter is mentioned contextually as an example of a death row exoneree in Illinois whose case contributed to Governor Ryan's decision to commute all death sentences.
organizations_involved_raw: Northwestern University's Center on Wrongful Convictions
